title: RynnValue: Scaling Robotic Value Foundation Models with Temporal Distance
abstract: arXiv:2608.09853v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: General-purpose reward models are increasingly the bottleneck for scaling robot learning, yet the recipe for learning value-related capabilities from large-scale heterogeneous corpora remains underexplored. Existing approaches tie supervision to task-internal anchors such as preferences or normalized progress, none of which transfer cleanly across embodiments and data sources. We introduce RynnValue, an open-source value foundation model for robotic manipulation that replaces these anchors with temporal distance, the directed cost-to-go from an observation to the language-specified goal. Because temporal-distance labels can be derived directly from timestamps, RynnValue scales to over 7,000 hours and roughly 3M instruction-conditioned clips without preference or progress annotations. translated_title: RynnValue：基于时间距离扩展机器人价值基础模型
translated_abstract: 通用奖励模型正日益成为扩展机器人学习的瓶颈，然而从大规模异构语料库中学习价值相关能力的有效方法仍未得到充分探索。现有方法将监督信号绑定于任务内部的锚点（如偏好或归一化进度），但这些锚点均无法在不同机器人本体和数据源之间顺畅迁移。我们提出RynnValue，一个面向机器人操作的开源价值基础模型，它用时间距离——即从某个观测到语言指定目标的有向代价——取代了这些锚点。由于时间距离标签可以直接从时间戳推导获得，RynnValue无需偏好或进度标注即可扩展至超过7,000小时、约300万条指令条件化片段的数据规模。为了使时间价值学习在大规模下保持可靠，我们结合了随机时间采样、时间顺序打乱与价值隔离注意力等方法……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: RynnValue以可直接从时间戳推导的“时间距离”（即从观测到语言指定目标的有向代价）替代偏好或进度等任务内监督锚点，从而无需人工标注即可扩展至7,000多小时、约300万片段，训练出开源的机器人操作价值基础模型。
en_tdlr: RynnValue is an open-source value foundation model for robotic manipulation that replaces preference- or progress-based supervision with temporal distance—the directed cost-to-go from an observation to a language-specified goal—enabling annotation-free scaling to 7,000+ hours and roughly 3M instruction-conditioned clips.
